_meta._note: MatterGen Nature paper (s41586-025-08628-5) verified SUN (Stable+Unique+Novel) yield percentages — fills the previously-empty mattergen_yield benchmark for W9 Materials Discovery widget. CDVAE + DiffCSP MP20 registered as competitor baselines per primary-source attribution.

models.name: CDVAE
models._note: Crystal Diffusion Variational AutoEncoder — early generative model for periodic materials. Baseline in MatterGen paper.

models.name: DiffCSP (MP-20)
models._note: Diffusion-based Crystal Structure Prediction model. Baseline in MatterGen paper.

benchmarks.name: MatterGen SUN Yield
benchmarks.description: Stable+Unique+Novel (SUN) yield rate for generative materials models. % of generated structures that are simultaneously thermodynamically stable, structurally unique, and not in MP20 training set. Per MatterGen Nature 2025 paper Table 1.

scores._note: MatterGen Nature 2025 paper Table 1 — SUN (Stable+Unique+Novel) rate = 38.57%. Sub-metrics: 74.41% stable, 100.0% unique, 61.96% novel. Best of generative models tested. SUN measures % of generated crystal structures that are simultaneously thermodynamically stable, structurally unique, and not in MP20 training set.
MatterGen Nature 2025 paper Table 1 — CDVAE baseline SUN rate = 13.99% (19.31% stable, 100.0% unique, 92.00% novel).
MatterGen Nature 2025 paper Table 1 — DiffCSP MP-20 baseline SUN rate = 12.71% (36.23% stable, 100.0% unique, 70.73% novel).
